migrations.preflight: Current function validates JSON and top-level object, but does not reject malformed nested story_craft; it backs up before replacing malformed nested values with defaults.
migrations.idempotency: fills absent defaults without duplicating keys
migrations.postcondition: state remains valid JSON; existing top-level fields preserved except story_craft is replaced when absent or malformed; not lossless for malformed nested values.
migrations.ambiguity_handling: Backup exists, but nested malformed value is not reported before replacement; do not treat as a lossless Story System migration.
migrations.retirement_criterion: A preflight/reporting mode and preservation behavior are tested, or all supported callers leave old shape and the migration support window closes after reviewed evidence.

migrations.preflight: validate source and destination formats before copy
migrations.rollback: restore backup and retain original JSON
migrations.ambiguity_handling: emit conflict report without silent winner selection
migrations.retirement_criterion: No supported callers and opted-in projects pass round-trip evidence.

existing_story_system.migration: schema preflight; no-op if no disk format change; unsupported schemas rejected

legacy.migration: no automatic migration on plugin update

mixed_partial.migration: diagnose and stop pending explicit repair
